dataset_title: Adverb – final particle collocations in Late Archaic Chinese
about: Adverbs (ADV) and sentence-final particles (FP) in Late Archaic Chinese. Mutual strength is pointwise mutual information (PMI). The one-way pulls are normalised Kullback-Leibler divergences: when you look at an adverb, the distance shows how strongly it narrows down which particle follows; when you look at a particle, how strongly it narrows down the adverb.
sample_text: 豈不誠大丈夫哉。蓋有之矣，我未之見也。
word_font_family: 'Noto Sans CJK TC', 'PingFang TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', 'Source Han Sans TC', sans-serif
